desc:

Welcome to Anime Apocalypse!
Anime Apocalypse is a fast-paced Anime dungeon hack-and-slash zombie game! Fight through zombie filled dungeons, obtain unique abilities, and play unique gamemodes!

Will you survive the Apocalypse?

⚔️ Hack-and-Slash Action
💥 Unique Anime Abilities

🎯 Pets, Loadouts & More!

🎮 Controls
M1 — LMB / X / Square
Skill 1 — Z / L2 / LT
Skill 2 — X / L1 / LB
Skill 3 — C / R1 / RB
Skill 4 — V / R2 / RT
Gadget — E / D-Pad Up
Ultimate — G / D-Pad Down
Dash — Q / B / Circle
Slide — Ctrl / Y / Triangle

scripts.title: NO M1 COOLDOWN OPEN SOURCE
scripts.script:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local CombatFolder = ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Modules.CombatData

for _, moduleScript in ipairs(CombatFolder:GetChildren()) do
    if moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript") then
        local success, data = pcall(require, moduleScript)

        if success and type(data) == "table" then
            for attackName, attack in pairs(data) do
                if type(attack) == "table" then
                    if attack.M1CD then
                        attack.M1CD = 0.1
                    end
                end
            end

            print("Modified:", moduleScript.Name)
        else
            warn("Failed to require:", moduleScript.Name)
        end
    end
end
